page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Instance-wide — independent of the selected team.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your work identity, notifications, and account security.
profile.usernameHint: Unique across the instance; used for @mentions.
profile.bioHint: {{length}}/200 — shown when teammates hover your avatar.
profile.timezoneHint: Applies to absolute timestamps. Due dates stay on the product's Persian calendar regardless of timezone.
profile.capacityHint: How many tasks you can comfortably carry (1–100). Shown as your utilization target in the team Capacity view.

avatar.label: Avatar — square JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is center-cropped automatically.

errors.usernameFormat: Username must be 3-32 characters of a-z, 0-9 or _.
errors.bioTooLong: Bio must be at most 200 characters.

password.changeHint: Changing your password signs out all other sessions.
password.rules: At least 12 characters with upper, lower, digit and special.

prefs.title: Notification preferences
prefs.subtitle: In-app notifications only. All events are on by default.

task_assigned.label: Task assigned
task_assigned.hint: Someone assigns a task to you

task_submitted.label: Task submitted
task_submitted.hint: An assignee submits work for review

task_status_changed.label: Status changed
task_status_changed.hint: A task you reported changes status

summary.title: My work
summary.subtitle: Counts are computed by the server; each number opens the matching list.

errors.load: Could not load your work summary.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices signed in to your account. Revoking a session signs that device out.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.subtitleEnabled: Enabled. Signing in requires a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.subtitleDisabled: Add a second factor with any TOTP app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…).
mfa.recoveryWarning: Store these recovery codes somewhere safe — they are shown only this once.
mfa.recoveryInfo: Each code works once instead of an authenticator code. Without a code or a recovery code you cannot sign in.
mfa.ackLabel: I stored these codes somewhere safe (a password manager or printed copy). They will not be shown again.
mfa.ackButton: I have stored my recovery codes

disableConfirm.title: Disable two-factor authentication?
disableConfirm.description: Your authenticator and all recovery codes stop working immediately.

regenConfirm.title: Generate new recovery codes?
regenConfirm.description: Every previously issued recovery code stops working.

errors.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Make sure your authenticator clock is correct and try the current code.
errors.enterCode: Enter the six-digit code from your app.

adminUsers.title: Users
adminUsers.subtitle: Instance-wide accounts — created here by an Owner, assigned to teams separately.
adminUsers.searchPlaceholder: Search by email, name or username…
adminUsers.typeEmail: Type the account email to hard-delete
adminUsers.deactivateHint: Leave both fields empty to just deactivate the account.

errors.loadHint: You may not be an instance Owner.
errors.required: Email and display name are required.

createDialog.title: Create instance user
createDialog.description: The account exists instance-wide — assign it to teams from each team's settings.
createDialog.tempPasswordHint: ≥ 12 characters with upper, lower, digit and special — enforced server-side.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.description: Soft-deactivate happens automatically. A hard delete requires typing the account's email and your password — it is refused while the account still has teams, tasks or comments.

addMember.title: Add member
addMember.description: Pick an existing Tasker account. Accounts are created by an Owner on the Users page — team membership is a separate assignment.
addMember.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or username…
addMember.noMatch: No existing Tasker user matches this search.
addMember.askOwner: Ask an Owner to create the account.

team.unavailableHint: Select a valid team from the switcher.
team.name: Name
team.avatarLabel: Team avatar — square JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

members.title: Members ({{total}})
members.empty: No members match the current filters.

removeConfirm.title: Remove this member?
removeConfirm.description: {{name}} loses access to the team and its projects; their task assignments are cleared.

guests.title: Guests
guests.subtitle: People with read-only viewer access to projects in this team.
guests.empty: No guests. Grant viewer access from a project's guest page.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke guest access?
revokeConfirm.viewerDescription: {{name}} loses viewer access to every project in this team.

teamGuests.title: Team guests
teamGuests.subtitle: Non-members with explicitly granted permissions. Default deny — every capability is a separate grant, revoked instantly.
teamGuests.addDescription: Pick an existing Tasker account. Guests get only what you explicitly grant.
teamGuests.findUserAria: Find a user to invite as guest

queue.title: Invitation requests
queue.descriptionAfter: grant can ask you to invite someone. Nothing changes until you decide.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.archiveNote: Marks the team as archived; reversible at any time.
dangerZone.archiveConfirmDescription: The team is marked as archived. You can restore it at any time.
dangerZone.restoreConfirmDescription: The team becomes fully active again.
dangerZone.deleteNote: Permanently deletes the team, all of its projects, tasks, and automation history. Owner only — type the team name and your password.
dangerZone.ownerOnlyTitle: Only the team owner can delete the team
dangerZone.deletedBody: {{name}} and all of its data were removed.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this team permanently?
deleteConfirm.before: This is irreversible: every project, task, comment, and automation of
deleteConfirm.after: will be deleted. Type the team name and your current password to confirm.

labels.title: Labels
labels.subtitle: Categorize tasks. Members with the Manager role or above can create them.
labels.name: Label name
labels.editDescription: Update the name, color or icon. Changes apply everywhere the label is used.

trash.title: Deleted projects
trash.subtitle: Projects stay here for 30 days before they can only be purged permanently.

purgeConfirm.title: Purge this project permanently?
purgeConfirm.before: This is irreversible: every task, comment, and dependency of
purgeConfirm.after: is deleted forever. Type the project name and your current password to confirm.

view_team.label: See the team
view_team.description: Team name and description appear in the switcher.

view_team_members.label: See the roster
view_team_members.description: Member names, roles and emails are visible.

view_project_list.label: Browse the project index
view_project_list.description: The list of the team's projects is visible (names only).

view_project_tasks.label: See the task list
view_project_tasks.description: The project's task list is visible.

view_task.label: Open tasks
view_task.description: Task titles and details are visible.

view_task_own.label: Open own tasks
view_task_own.description: Only tasks assigned to this guest are visible.

view_task_dates.label: See due dates
view_task_dates.description: Due dates and deadlines are visible.

view_task_comments.label: Read the discussion
view_task_comments.description: Comments marked visible to guests are readable.

comment_task.label: Comment on tasks
comment_task.description: The guest can post comments on tasks.

view_task_attachments.label: See the file list
view_task_attachments.description: Attachment names and metadata are visible.

upload_task_attachments.label: Attach files
upload_task_attachments.description: The guest can upload attachments (implies commenting).

invite_guest.label: Request guest invitations
invite_guest.description: The guest can ask you to invite someone; you approve or reject.

view_audit_log.label: Read the audit log
view_audit_log.description: The team's audit trail is visible.

perm.footer_one: {{count}} team-scoped grant; the rest are scoped per project. Saving applies every add and removal in one pass — a failed step rolls the batch back.
perm.footer_other: {{count}} team-scoped grants; the rest are scoped per project. Saving applies every add and removal in one pass — a failed step rolls the batch back.
perm.blockedByViewTask: Covered by “Open tasks” — view_task already includes own tasks.

toasts.rollback: Could not save permissions — changes rolled back
